primary.title: IT stocks Q2 results analysis: Infosys vs TCS vs Wipro vs HCL vs TechM: Who wins profit, revenue, dividend, AI race?
primary.summary: Q2FY27 results showed diverging fortunes among India’s largest IT firms. Tech Mahindra topped profit and revenue growth, HCLTech improved its outlook, and TCS led in deal wins and AI revenue scale. Infosys offered the biggest interim dividend, while Wipro reported the weakest trends in profit.
